purpose: Define the source materials required before guardrail verification scripts may move from STUB to ACTIVE.

canonicalization_algorithm_spec.description: Deterministic byte-level canonicalization rules for receipt artifacts.

receipt_schema_target.description: Committed schema file or schema identifier used to validate receipt shape.

hash_algorithm_specification.description: Explicit digest algorithm and encoding rules used for content identity.

replay_input_specification.description: Declared input files and parameters required to reproduce replay checks.

deterministic_execution_contract.description: Rules that define deterministic execution, failure behavior, and environment assumptions.

baseline_commit_anchor.description: Git commit hash used as the baseline for replay comparison.

activation_rule: Scripts may return ACTIVE only after every required source is committed, parseable, and checked by executable code.
